_doc: HANDOFF v1.3 §6.3 counterparty model: P(accept) = sigmoid(a0 + a*dTitle_them + b*(fc_fairness - 1) + c*need_fit_them + d*bias_mgr + e*urgency_them). ESTIMATED priors, set by judgment and never fitted: Yahoo exposes only completed trades, not declined offers, so there is no data to fit an acceptance model on (decided with Chris 2026-09-27; cards label the odds 'est.'). a0 is an intercept added to the handoff formula so a neutral offer reads as more likely declined than accepted.

_units.a: per unit of title probability: +5pp for them is +1.0 logit
_units.b: per unit of FantasyCalc ratio (what they receive / what they give): 0.9 is -0.4 logit
_units.c: need_fit_them is 1 when the player they receive starts for them, else 0
_units.d: bias_mgr is their positional multiplier on what they receive minus on what they give (Undisputed, RB-heavy: an RB for a WR is +0.15)
_units.e: urgency_them is 1.0 at 25-50% playoff odds, 0.5 at 10-25% or 50-70%, 0 otherwise

flags._doc: (J) flag from P(accept); EXPLOIT = reasonably likely AND it lowers their title odds
